slot.brief: Block on incline with applied force shown in diagram; find range of force for equilibrium given friction coefficient

stem: A $2\ \text{kg}$ block is at rest on a rough plane inclined at $45^\circ$. A horizontal force $F$ is applied as shown in the figure. If the coefficient of static friction is $\dfrac{1}{3}$, the range of $F$ for which the block remains in equilibrium is (take $g=10\ \text{m s}^{-2}$):

verdicts.working: Along the plane, the net applied force before friction is (F−20)/√2; the normal force is (F+20)/√2. Equilibrium requires |F−20|/√2 ≤ (F+20)/(3√2), giving 10 N ≤ F ≤ 40 N.

working:
$N=\dfrac{mg+F}{\sqrt{2}}$, and the required friction magnitude is $\dfrac{|mg-F|}{\sqrt{2}}$. 
$\dfrac{|mg-F|}{\sqrt{2}}\le\dfrac{N}{3}\Rightarrow 3|mg-F|\le mg+F$. 
For $F\le mg$: $F\ge\dfrac{mg}{2}$. For $F\ge mg$: $F\le2mg$. 
With $mg=20\ \text{N}$: $10\ \text{N}\le F\le40\ \text{N}$.

Independent check: Along the plane, the net applied force before friction is (F−20)/√2; the normal force is (F+20)/√2. Equilibrium requires |F−20|/√2 ≤ (F+20)/(3√2), giving 10 N ≤ F ≤ 40 N.
solution:
The normal reaction is $N=\dfrac{mg+F}{\sqrt{2}}$, and equilibrium requires friction $\dfrac{|mg-F|}{\sqrt{2}}\leq\mu N$.
$$3|20-F|\leq 20+F$$
For $F\leq20$, this gives $F\geq10$; for $F\geq20$, it gives $F\leq40$. Thus, $10\ \text{N}\leq F\leq40\ \text{N}$.
